venues.name: Great Stirrup Cay Cruise Pier
venues.notes: Two-ship permanent pier, opened 28 December 2025. Ships dock directly, no tendering.

venues.name: Tender Landing
venues.notes: Original tender landing used before the pier opened. May still be used as a backup or for excursion boats. Confirm whether it is still in service.

venues.name: Welcome Plaza
venues.notes: Open-air arrivals hub at the base of the pier, with seating, island maps and directional signage.

venues.name: Welcome Center
venues.notes: Air-conditioned arrivals and reception building that opened December 2025.

venues.name: Shore Excursion Desk
venues.notes: Books WaveRunner tours, stingray encounters and snorkeling on the island.

venues.name: Complimentary Lockers
venues.notes: Free lockers for day guests.

venues.name: Beach Wheelchair Pickup
venues.notes: Beach wheelchairs are described as available near the island entrance. Exact pickup point not published.

venues.name: Welcome Plaza Restrooms
venues.notes: Restrooms at the Welcome Plaza, the first set of restrooms after the pier.

venues.name: First Aid Station
venues.notes: Medical help is available on the island for emergencies but no source publishes the location of a first aid hut. Look for a staffed hut near the Welcome Plaza or the main beach and place it where you actually see it.

venues.name: Overlook Bridge
venues.notes: Described as an overlook bridge at the Welcome Plaza. Single source only.

venues.name: Tram Stop: Welcome Plaza
venues.notes: NCL does not publish official tram stop names. This stop is named here after the area it serves.

venues.name: Tram Stop: Great Life Lagoon
venues.notes: NCL does not publish official tram stop names. This stop is named here after the area it serves.

venues.name: Tram Stop: Main Beach and Jumbey Beach Grill
venues.notes: NCL does not publish official tram stop names. This stop is named here after the area it serves.

venues.name: Tram Stop: Cabana Beach
venues.notes: NCL does not publish official tram stop names. This stop is named here after the area it serves.

venues.name: Tram Stop: Great Tides Waterpark
venues.notes: A waterpark tram stop was planned while the park was under construction. Confirm it exists now that the park is open.

venues.name: Tram Stop: Vibe Shore Club
venues.notes: NCL does not publish official tram stop names. This stop is named here after the area it serves.

venues.name: Tram Stop: Silver Cove
venues.notes: NCL does not publish official tram stop names. This stop is named here after the area it serves.

venues.name: Great Life Lagoon
venues.notes: Resort-style heated pool of about 28,000 square feet with a zero-entry beach-style edge. Opened 2025.

venues.name: Reef Bar
venues.notes: Swim-up bar in Great Life Lagoon. NCL's island page also calls it the Reef Swim Bar.

venues.name: The Waves Bar
venues.notes: Second swim-up bar in Great Life Lagoon.

venues.name: Great Life Lagoon Cabanas
venues.notes: Ring of private cabanas around the lagoon, sold in three types.

venues.name: Splash Harbor
venues.notes: Complimentary kids splash pad with small slides, interactive features and a large tipping bucket.

venues.name: Harborside Shops
venues.notes: Kiosks under yellow, orange and blue umbrellas, added December 2025. Also referred to as Harborside Market.

venues.name: Abaco Taco
venues.notes: Casual made-to-order taco stand, complimentary. Described as being on the northern part of the island.

venues.name: Great Life Lagoon Restrooms
venues.notes: Restrooms and showers are described as available around the pool complex. Exact building not published.

venues.name: Great Tides Waterpark Entrance
venues.notes: Ticketed entrance to the nearly six-acre waterpark that opened 4 September 2026.

venues.name: Tidal Tower
venues.notes: 170-foot slide tower, the focal point of the waterpark.

venues.name: Breakwater Blasters
venues.notes: Water coaster slides on Tidal Tower.

venues.name: Whitewater Dash
venues.notes: Slide on Tidal Tower.

venues.name: Rapid Mat Racers
venues.notes: Mat racing slides on Tidal Tower.

venues.name: Tropic Storm
venues.notes: Slide on Tidal Tower.

venues.name: Tropic Spiral
venues.notes: Slide on Tidal Tower.

venues.name: Cliffside Cove
venues.notes: Cliff jump and racing slide zone with its own pool.

venues.name: Cliffside Leap
venues.notes: Cliff jump platforms at Cliffside Cove.

venues.name: Fearless Falls
venues.notes: Drop slides at Cliffside Cove.

venues.name: The Great Slide
venues.notes: Four-person body slide at Cliffside Cove.

venues.name: Wandering River
venues.notes: River ride over 800 feet long with an immersive tunnel.

venues.name: Splash Cay
venues.notes: Kids splash zone of over 9,000 square feet inside the waterpark.

venues.name: Grotto Bar
venues.notes: Bar tucked beneath The Great Slide at Cliffside Cove.

venues.name: Floataway Bar
venues.notes: Bar served from within the Wandering River.

venues.name: Hampton Water
venues.notes: Beverage station in the Tidal Tower area.

venues.name: Coca-Cola Station
venues.notes: Drink station at Splash Cay.

venues.name: Low Tide Smoke
venues.notes: Barbecue food truck inside the waterpark.

venues.name: Catch of the Cay
venues.notes: Seafood food truck inside the waterpark.

venues.name: Tidal Treats
venues.notes: Ice cream and soft serve food truck inside the waterpark.

venues.name: Great Tides Waterpark Cabanas
venues.notes: Private cabanas for up to six guests inside the waterpark.

venues.name: Great Tides Waterpark Restrooms
venues.notes: A park this size has restrooms and changing rooms, but no source publishes where they sit. Place them where you see them on the imagery.

venues.name: Bertram's Cove
venues.notes: The main swimming beach, named for Captain Allan Bertram. Best snorkeling is at the far end.

venues.name: Jumbey Beach
venues.notes: Name used for the main sandy beach in front of Jumbey Beach Grill. Also spelled Jumby Beach. May be the same stretch as Bertram's Cove.

venues.name: Cabana Beach
venues.notes: Name used for the beach stretch lined with rental cabanas. Not an official NCL name in current material.

venues.name: Lagoon Beach
venues.notes: Name used for the beach nearest Great Life Lagoon. Not an official NCL name in current material.

venues.name: Jumbey Beach Grill
venues.notes: Main complimentary buffet on the island, barbecue and picnic style, with four food lines.

venues.name: Bacardi Bar
venues.notes: Beach bar with rum cocktails, mojitos and daiquiris, with outdoor seating.

venues.name: Bertram's Bar
venues.notes: Beach bar on the main beach.

venues.name: Patron Bar
venues.notes: Beach bar with tequila cocktails and frozen drink machines. Tagged in OpenStreetMap as Patron Tequila.

venues.name: Sandbar
venues.notes: Bar building mapped in OpenStreetMap next to Patron Bar. Not named in any current NCL material, so it may have been renamed or removed.

venues.name: Lighthouse Beach Bar
venues.notes: Described as located near the cabanas. Confirm it is still open under this name.

venues.name: Tropic Like It's Hot
venues.notes: Food truck serving Bahamian inspired sandwiches and grilled fish, described as sitting closer to Silver Cove.

venues.name: Premier Cabanas
venues.notes: Beachfront rental cabanas on the main beach.

venues.name: Cabanas on the Cay
venues.notes: Older NCL name for the beach cabana cluster. Confirm whether the name is still in use.

venues.name: Over-the-Water Swings
venues.notes: Photo spot, swings set over the shallow water.

venues.name: Underwater Sculpture Garden
venues.notes: Snorkeling attraction off the far end of Bertram's Cove with stone mermaids, starfish, treasure chests and skulls.

venues.name: Snorkel Rentals
venues.notes: Snorkel gear rental hut on the beach.

venues.name: Sand Volleyball Courts
venues.notes: Volleyball courts on the public beach.

venues.name: Berried Treasures Bazaar
venues.notes: Straw market of colorful huts run by independent Bahamian vendors from Great Harbour Cay. Cash only.

venues.name: Main Beach Restrooms
venues.notes: Restrooms are described as available along the main beach. Exact building not published.

venues.name: Water Tour Departure Point
venues.notes: Departure point on the beach for WaveRunner, kayak and boat tours.

venues.name: WaveRunner Tours
venues.notes: Guided WaveRunner tours around the cay.

venues.name: Kayak Tours
venues.notes: Guided kayaking tours from the beach.

venues.name: Treasure Island Stingray and Pig Encounter
venues.notes: Excursion to a nearby island for stingray and swimming pig encounters. Place the marker at its departure dock.

venues.name: Vibe Shore Club
venues.notes: Adults-only beach club, 18 and over, sold as an all-day pass.

venues.name: Vibe Shore Club Bar
venues.notes: Private bar inside Vibe Shore Club, with roaming bar service on the sand.

venues.name: Vibe Shore Club Buffet
venues.notes: Private buffet for pass holders, with seafood, salads and desserts.

venues.name: Vibe Shore Club Cabanas
venues.notes: Beach cabanas for two and premium cabanas near the tree line for six to eight.

venues.name: Vibe Shore Club Restrooms
venues.notes: Restrooms and outdoor showers are described inside the club. Exact building not published.

venues.name: Silver Cove
venues.notes: Exclusive oceanfront retreat at the far end of the island, for villa guests, Haven guests and spa guests.

venues.name: Silver Cove Reception
venues.notes: Check-in building for Silver Cove.

venues.name: Silver Cove Restaurant
venues.notes: Private restaurant serving Silver Cove guests.

venues.name: Silver Cove Bar
venues.notes: Bar attached to the Silver Cove restaurant.

venues.name: Moet and Chandon Bar
venues.notes: Champagne bar inside Silver Cove. Also written as the Moet Bar.

venues.name: Mandara Spa
venues.notes: Beachfront spa. Booking a treatment is one of the ways to get into Silver Cove.

venues.name: Silver Cove Pool
venues.notes: Private pool inside Silver Cove.

venues.name: Silver Cove Ocean Villas
venues.notes: Air-conditioned beachfront villas, studio through two bedroom.

venues.name: Silver Cove Lagoon Villas
venues.notes: Air-conditioned villas on the lagoon side of Silver Cove.

venues.name: Silver Cove Gazebo
venues.notes: Gazebo shown in the Silver Cove area on the onboard map.

venues.name: Silver Cove Restrooms
venues.notes: Restrooms inside Silver Cove. Exact building not published.

venues.name: Great Stirrup Cay Lighthouse
venues.notes: Stone lighthouse built in 1863, about 80 feet tall, now solar powered and automated.

venues.name: Flighthouse Zipline
venues.notes: Zipline course that starts at the lighthouse, with six ziplines, net bridges, chimney climbs and cargo nets, up to about 120 feet above the ground.

venues.name: Allan Bertram Gravesite
venues.notes: Grave of Captain Allan Bertram, who died in 1834 and asked to be buried on the island.

venues.name: Great Stirrup Cay International Airport Sign
venues.notes: Helicopter airfield in the southern part of the island with a joke sign reading Great Stirrup Cay International Airport. Confirm guests can still reach it.

venues.name: Target Rock
venues.notes: Named islet off the west end of Great Stirrup Cay, from OpenStreetMap.

venues.name: Snake Cay
venues.notes: Named islet off the south side of Great Stirrup Cay, from OpenStreetMap.

venues.name: Hammock Bay
venues.notes: Reported as an area with more than fifty hammocks and a nearby barbecue buffet. Not named in current NCL material. Skip it if you cannot see it.

venues.name: Horizon Park
venues.notes: Reported as lawn games, pickleball courts, a nine-hole mini golf course and a half sports court. Not named in current NCL material. Skip it if you cannot see it.

venues.name: LandShark Bar and Grill
venues.notes: Reported as an a la carte eatery with indoor and outdoor seating. Not named in current NCL material. Skip it if you cannot see it.

venues.name: Lagoon Retreat
venues.notes: Reported as an adults-only private beach area with villas. This may be an earlier plan name for what opened as Vibe Shore Club. Skip it if you cannot see it.

venues.name: Silver Palm Restaurant
venues.notes: Reported as a complimentary restaurant in the Lagoon Retreat area. Not named in current NCL material. Skip it if you cannot see it.

venues.name: Tidepool Town
venues.notes: Reported as a kids splash zone of about 9,000 square feet. This is probably an earlier plan name for Splash Cay. Skip it if you cannot see it.

venues.name: Splash Town
venues.notes: Reported as an interactive fountain area of about 3,400 square feet. This may be an earlier plan name for Splash Harbor. Skip it if you cannot see it.

venues.name: Mini Jet Kart Racecourse
venues.notes: Reported as a mini jet kart racecourse. Not named in current NCL material. Skip it if you cannot see it.
